from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.SLANT_WORKER_DIRECT,
                prompt_custom.SLANT_WORKER_CLUE_FIRST,
                prompt_custom.SLANT_WORKER_LOOP_AWARE,
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SLANT_STAR_AGGREGATOR,
        )
        solution = await star(problem)
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

- A clue grid of size R x C implies a slash-cell grid of size (R-1) x (C-1).
- Each dot "." means no clue at that vertex.
- Each cell contains exactly one diagonal.
- Use 1 to represent "/" and -1 to represent "\\".
- Enforce all numbered vertex counts and avoid closed loops.

Do not use fence labels like ```text or ```txt.

{problem}
